title: Degree and twist estimates for circle-tree invariants
status: Draft; full invariant and centered microscopic meridian asymptotic under the summed degree-and-twist criterion
imports: Exact moving-meridian crossing traces, full tree contraction and physical scalar ledger from Exact Newton calculus for tangles with a moving meridian, Proposition 6.1, Theorem 7.1 and Proposition 8.1.
Canonical factorial interpolation from Holomorphic source asymptotics and volume limits for strict Conway compositions, Lemma 2.1; no Conway tangle-grammar hypothesis is used for this analytic lemma.
The original positive geometric completion and absolute action-volume equality from Positive octahedra and primitive fillings for trees of crossing circles, Theorem 1.1.

All-index bounds, complex edge sums, summed-criterion Fourier tails and nonzero first-charge asymptotic are proved here. The independent long-twist theorem is not substituted for this criterion, which permits zero power at high degree.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
